The structure of Na2Co4N4 (Na(CoN)2) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers in octahedral coordination by six N neighbors, while N centers have two Co neighbors; Na centers exhibit a 14-vertex coordination environment. Corner-sharing between Co octahedra is observed, alongside corner- and edge-sharing between Co octahedra and Na polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites.
